mainEntity.name: Can any doorway be widened for accessibility, or are there limits?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many home accessibility projects, a doorway can be a candidate for widening if the wall layout, framing, and nearby plumbing or wiring allow it. Denver-area residential remodel work requires permits when changing the size of a doorway opening or creating a new one, so the opening should be evaluated before any demolition starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not every doorway is a good candidate. Load-bearing walls, utilities, and nearby finishes can limit how far a doorway can be enlarged, and permit requirements may apply when the opening size changes.
